name: Chaemin Jang
lead: I study the gap between what language models learn and what they can actually use.
bio: I am an M.S. student at the School of Computing, KAIST, co-advised by Jihee Kim and Dongman Lee. My work examines factual recall, internal representations, and how learned knowledge shapes model behavior.
home_description: Chaemin Jang is a researcher at KAIST studying what language models learn, remember, and produce. Publications, preprints, and CV.
og_description: Research on knowledge, retrieval, and behavior in language models.
